subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add a configurable non-USD currency contract for local model-cost estimates, and if so should it be provider-scoped, model-scoped, global, or display-only?
rationale: Current source and docs define local configured model costs as USD estimates while provider-reported billing has a separate currency-aware path, so automation should not choose the public config/accounting contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope, validation, mixed-currency aggregation, persisted naming, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Document that configured model costs remain USD estimates and leave currency-aware values to provider-reported billing surfaces.

options.title: Allow a display-only override
options.body: Add a narrow symbol or ISO display override only if storage and aggregation remain explicitly estimate/display semantics.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope, validation, mixed-currency aggregation, persisted naming, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent usage and provider-billing history makes this the closest current product/data-contract ownership signal.
